vertical_datum: LAS07 (Lithuanian Height System, normal heights, EVRF2007 realisation) - as NZT delivers its LiDAR; Potree conversion dropped the LAS CRS records, not re-verified
layout: row-major; row 0 is the southern edge (y = origin.y .. origin.y+cell), column 0 the western edge; value = median class-2 z in the cell; cells with no ground points (under buildings) are filled by neighbour averaging and listed as 0 in 'measured'
